description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomerOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/customer-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductInquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerApproval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomerOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SalesProcess" name="Sales process" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_ProductInquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Customer approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CustomerApproval" messageRef="Message_CustomerApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Process customer order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_ProductInquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Approval" messageRef="Message_CustomerApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Other"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inquiry_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Address" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_Interest" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested_Selection" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="EndEvent_Other"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selection_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_Approval" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_CustomerApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Event_CustomerApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
